author: Karl Rock
description:
Stepping into the hauntingly beautiful Makli Necropolis, one of the largest funerary sites in the world. This stunning structure belongs to Mirza Isa Khan Tarkhan, who commissioned his own mausoleum a full 14 years before his passing.

Located in Thatta, Pakistan, this site dates back to the 16th century, standing as a testament to the Tarkhan dynasty’s architectural legacy.

Despite heavy restorations needed to survive centuries of natural disasters, the intricate stone carvings remain mesmerizing.

Walking inside feels like entering another era, where the air instantly turns ice-cold, preserving the quiet history of this ancient house of the dead.
title: You've NEVER Seen a Tomb Like This! 🇵🇰
